last_attempts_log.asr_text: Everyone wants to value the time they spend learning. I think we agree on that. But when a decision is wrong, what people lose and how much they have to take on themselves are different. So we do not all have the same standard for saying it was a good choice. The power to decide where the money goes, the power to run a classroom, and the responsibility to manage one's own life are not the same thing. And even if you have little say in what is decided, the weight of the decision is not necessarily any lighter. Even if you have something deeply important to protect, that does not mean you will have a say in the decision. Whose understanding is still waiting to be put into words?
